chemistry-killer-01.title: Massaning saqlanishi, tarkibning doimiylik qonuni, ekzotermik va endotermik reaksiyalar
chemistry-killer-01.topic: Massaning saqlanishi, tarkibning doimiylik qonuni, ekzotermik va endotermik reaksiyalar
chemistry-killer-01.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-01.material:
Mis (Cu) kukuni yopiq idishda kislorod ($\mathrm{O_2}$) bilan reaksiyaga kirishtirilib mis(II) oksid ($\mathrm{CuO}$) hosil qilish tajribasi o‘tkazildi. Barcha tajribalarda idish ichidagi $\mathrm{O_2}$ 2,0 g, reaksiya esa $\mathrm{2Cu + O_2 \rightarrow 2CuO}$. Reaksiyadan keyin hosil bo‘lgan CuO massasi quyidagicha.
(A) Cu 4,0 g → CuO 5,0 g
(B) Cu 8,0 g → CuO 10,0 g
(C) Cu 12,0 g → CuO 10,0 g
O‘zgarmas tarkib qonuni shu sharoitda bajarilganda, shu idishda Cu 14,0 g va $\mathrm{O_2}$ 4,0 g ni reaktivlardan biri to‘liq sarflanguncha reaksiyaga kirishtirilgan natija sifatida to‘g‘risi qaysi?
chemistry-killer-01.thinking.0: Massaning saqlanishi, tarkibning doimiylik qonuni, ekzotermik va endotermik reaksiyalar
chemistry-killer-01.s.s1.prompt:
Mis (Cu) kukuni yopiq idishda kislorod ($\mathrm{O_2}$) bilan reaksiyaga kirishtirilib mis(II) oksid ($\mathrm{CuO}$) hosil qilish tajribasi o‘tkazildi. Barcha tajribalarda idish ichidagi $\mathrm{O_2}$ 2,0 g, reaksiya esa $\mathrm{2Cu + O_2 \rightarrow 2CuO}$. Reaksiyadan keyin hosil bo‘lgan CuO massasi quyidagicha.
(A) Cu 4,0 g → CuO 5,0 g
(B) Cu 8,0 g → CuO 10,0 g
(C) Cu 12,0 g → CuO 10,0 g
O‘zgarmas tarkib qonuni shu sharoitda bajarilganda, shu idishda Cu 14,0 g va $\mathrm{O_2}$ 4,0 g ni reaktivlardan biri to‘liq sarflanguncha reaksiyaga kirishtirilgan natija sifatida to‘g‘risi qaysi?
chemistry-killer-01.s.s1.explain:
1-bosqich: Cu ko‘paytirilsa ham CuO 10,0 g dan oshmaydigan (C) idishdagi $\mathrm{O_2}$ 2,0 g to‘liq reaksiyaga kirgan holat, shuning uchun CuO 10,0 g = Cu 8,0 g + O 2,0 g, ya’ni Cu:O = 4:1 (tekshirish: (A) Cu 4,0 g + O 1,0 g = 5,0 g, O qoladi; (B) Cu 8,0 g + O 2,0 g = 10,0 g aniq mos; (C) Cu 4,0 g qoladi).
2-bosqich: Cu 14,0 g bilan to‘liq reaksiyaga kiradigan O massasi = $14.0 \times \frac{1}{4} = 3.5$ g. Berilgan $\mathrm{O_2}$ 4,0 g ko‘proq bo‘lgani uchun Cu to‘liq reaksiyaga kirishadi va $\mathrm{O_2}$ $4.0-3.5=0.5$ g qoladi.
3-bosqich: hosil bo‘lgan CuO = 14,0 + 3,5 = 17,5 g (massaning saqlanishi, tarkib nisbati Cu:O:CuO = 4:1:5).
Demak to‘g‘ri javob a: CuO 17,5 g hosil bo‘ladi, $\mathrm{O_2}$ 0,5 g qoladi. (Noto‘g‘ri javoblar: 18,0 g massa yig‘indisi reaksiyaga kirishmagan O ni ham qo‘shgan qiymat, 20,0 g esa O 4,0 g asosida hisoblab Cu yetishmasligini e’tiborsiz qoldirgan qiymat)

chemistry-killer-01.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
chemistry-killer-01.s.s1.hint.0: Cu qoladigan (C) da CuO 10,0 g ichida idishdagi O 2,0 g to‘liq bor → Cu:O massa nisbatini topib, qaysi biri yetishmasligini solishtiring. Mahsulot massasi = reaksiyaga kirgan Cu + reaksiyaga kirgan O.
